title: alnus rugosa f. tomophylla
intro: Alnus rugosa f. tomophylla, commonly known as the Korean green alder, is a plant species in the birch family. It is a variant of the alder tree, known for its unique properties and medicinal uses. The health benefits of Alnus rugosa f. tomophylla include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
